purpose: Evidence for the governance-attested historical high-water mark of the Base cross-chain Strategy

sampling.method: Multicall3.aggregate3 -> totalAssets()/totalSupply() at each pinned block; ceiling PPS = ceil(assets*1e18/supply)

bound.statement: PPS never decreased across 1101 hourly samples spanning the whole lifetime, so the historical maximum equals the head ceiling PPS up to at most 6 ppm of unsampled intra-interval accrual.

attestation.policy: Ceiling PPS at the execution block, plus a bounded submission-window margin
attestation.marginBasis: Measured lifetime accrual is 44767 ppm/year = 122.6 ppm/day = 5.11 ppm/hour = 0.085 ppm/minute of PPS. A one-hour submission-window margin is therefore 6 ppm (ceil of 5.11), about 6e12 wei-units on a 1e18 scale, i.e. 0.0006% of PPS. That direction is user-favourable: performance fees only ever accrue above the attested mark. The margin keeps the on-chain check (HWM >= fresh ceiling PPS at the execution block) satisfiable across plan generation, signing and inclusion.
attestation.feeContext: managementFee and performanceFee are both 0 on this Strategy, so no fee accrues at or after initialization; the mark binds only if a fee is later enabled through its own governance path.
